homepage.title: Different goals. Same need for proof.
homepage.lede: Everyone approaches cards differently. FlipForge gives them a disciplined way to understand their decisions.

framework.name: Get the decision, and the why

homepage.disclosure: How one FlipForge framework applies to different goals. FlipForge is decision support: it does not guarantee profit, investment returns or a grade.

audiences.name: Collectors
audiences.pain: You want the card, but you do not want enthusiasm to hide weak evidence.
audiences.value: FlipForge separates the exact-card facts from the story and shows what still needs verification.
audiences.cta: Inspect the decision before you buy.

homepage.label: Collectors
homepage.headline: Inspect the decision before you buy.
homepage.question: Is this the exact card I want, and is the price supported for it?

signals.identity: Year, set, number, parallel and grade are checked before any price is compared.
signals.evidence: You see which prices are reported sales of this exact card, and which are asking prices or a different card.
signals.maxbuy: Supported value from qualifying sales shows whether the asking price is ahead of the evidence.
signals.decision: WATCH when the price runs ahead of the evidence. VERIFY when the card or its comparisons are unresolved.

homepage.why: You may never sell it. You still want to know it is the right card at a price the evidence supports.

audiences.name: Investors
audiences.pain: A chart can show what happened without telling you whether today’s opportunity is defensible.
audiences.value: FlipForge connects identity, evidence, economics, risk, and outcome tracking into one decision record.
audiences.cta: See the reasoning, not just the trend.

homepage.label: Investors
homepage.headline: See the reasoning, not just the trend.
homepage.question: What does the evidence support today, and can I review this decision later?

signals.identity: The exact card is locked, so every later review looks at the same card.
signals.evidence: Qualifying sales, how thin the market is, and the risk that remains are shown side by side.
signals.maxbuy: Max Buy at your own costs. For cards you own, a break-even price for each selling channel.
signals.decision: Saved decisions stay frozen with their evidence and can be reviewed at Days 7, 14 and 30.

homepage.why: A long hold starts with one purchase. A frozen, explained decision shows later what you knew and why you acted. FlipForge does not forecast returns.

audiences.name: Flippers
audiences.pain: An apparent spread disappears fast when comps are wrong, liquidity is weak, or costs are ignored.
audiences.value: FlipForge pressure-tests the spread before you commit capital.
audiences.cta: Test the margin before you chase it.

homepage.label: Flippers
homepage.headline: Test the margin before you chase it.
homepage.question: After fees, shipping and the margin I want to keep, is there still a deal at this price?

signals.identity: Exact parallel and grade, so the spread is measured against the card you would actually resell.
signals.evidence: Asking prices and stale sales are set aside, and a thin market is flagged.
signals.maxbuy: Max Buy after your fees, shipping and target margin, with the gap to the asking price.
signals.decision: PASS when the margin is not there. WATCH when the cushion is thin.

homepage.why: A spread only exists after costs, and only while buyers are still there. FlipForge shows both before you commit capital.

audiences.name: Dealers
audiences.pain: Inventory decisions compound quickly when a weak comp or identity mismatch slips through.
audiences.value: FlipForge creates a repeatable decision process your inventory review can trace later.
audiences.cta: Make inventory decisions you can explain.

homepage.label: Dealers
homepage.headline: Make inventory decisions you can explain.
homepage.question: Should this card come into inventory at this price, and could I explain the call later?

signals.identity: Every buy is checked against the exact card, so a mismatched parallel does not enter inventory at the wrong cost.
signals.evidence: The same evidence rules on every card, with a reason for every price set aside.
signals.maxbuy: Max Buy at your own fees and margin. A break-even price for each card you hold.
signals.decision: Each saved decision keeps its evidence and reasoning, so it can be traced later.

homepage.why: When you buy many cards, consistency matters. The same rules on every card make each purchase traceable. Dealer-specific workflows are not offered yet.

audiences.name: Grading users
audiences.pain: Population and grade spread matter, but they do not answer the whole purchase decision.
audiences.value: FlipForge keeps grading intelligence in context with evidence, economics, and uncertainty.
audiences.cta: Use grade context without losing the full decision.

homepage.label: Grading-focused buyers
homepage.headline: Use grade context without losing the full decision.
homepage.question: Do sales of this card, at this grader and this grade, support the premium I am paying?

signals.identity: Grader and grade are part of the card’s identity. A different grade is a different card.
signals.evidence: Sales that name a different grader or grade, or that are marked raw, are set aside.
signals.maxbuy: Max Buy for the slab, built from sales at that grader and grade.
signals.decision: VERIFY when the grader or grade cannot be confirmed.

homepage.why: A grade premium is real only when sales at that exact grade support it. FlipForge does not predict the grade a raw card will receive.
